privileged_info_for_vlm: Bromine: Liquid, dark reddish-brown, pungent odor, BP: 139.2°F (59.6°C), MP: 19°F (-7.2°C). Potassium permanganate: Solid (crystalline), purple/dark purple, odorless, BP: Decomposes, MP: Decomposes at < 464°F (< 240°C). Hydrazine: Colorless fuming liquid, fishy/ammonia-like odor, BP: 236.3°F (113.5°C), MP: 35.6°F (2°C). Carbon disulfide: Clear colorless/faint yellow liquid, strong/disagreeable odor, BP: 115.3°F (46.3°C), MP: -169.1°F (-111.7°C). Titanium tetrachloride: Colorless to light yellow liquid, penetrating/acid odor, BP: 277.5°F (136.4°C), MP: -11.2°F (-24°C). Note: CAMEO values are the primary source; small rounding differences in conversions are acceptable.
